Euryodeia: mother of King Arcesius of Ithaca
Halitherses: Ithacan seer in the Odyssey
Homeric Ithaca: Odysseus's home island in the Odyssey
Ithome: Messenian nymph, nurse of Zeus
Laertes: king of Ithaca and father of Odysseus
Odysseus (Ulysses): legendary hero and king of Ithaca in Greek myth
Penelope: wife of Odysseus, queen of Ithaca
